name: Late session turn match
description: late_session matches from the third user turn onward (turn_index >= 2)

name: Early session turn falls through
description: A second user turn has turn_index 1, so late_session does not fire and multi_turn_user wins

name: Multi-turn user history match
description: multi_turn_user matches once the conversation has two or more user messages (two user turns stay below the late_session threshold)

name: Developer message match
description: has_developer_message matches when the request includes a developer-role message

messages.content: Always answer in a formal tone.

name: No conversation rule matches
description: A single-turn request with no developer message matches neither multi_turn_user nor has_developer_message
